scope.in_scope_definition: A symbol is in scope for 1.0 iff its R package is not listed in out_of_scope_packages. See stats.in_scope_exports for the count.
scope.counting_note: Out-of-scope exports are still enumerated in the per-symbol matrix for completeness and ARE included in raw totals (e.g. r_exports_total / surface_missing); they are NOT OmniLSS 1.0 delivery targets and do not count against 1.0 completeness. Filter on in_scope / in_scope_exports for the 1.0 figure.
scope.notice: gamlss2 is out of scope for OmniLSS 1.0: separate spec / version / evidence, does not block 1.0 (deliverable plan sections 1.2, 22.6).

category_meaning.missing: R 导出符号在 Python 侧没有任何 surface（surface 层为 missing）
category_meaning.placeholder: 家族以 placeholder 核注册（kernel 层为 placeholder）
category_meaning.compat_alias: 家族以兼容别名提供（kernel 层为 compat_alias）
category_meaning.evidence_gap: 已实现但完全没有测试证据（parity 层为 unverified）
category_meaning.extra: Python 独有的公开导出（omnilss.__all__ 中无 R 对应项），仅报告
